name: Tel Marum I — The Gateway
dispatch: For a week the north woke to rockets and nobody could say from where. On the eighth morning one settlement took nine before the sirens stopped. No launch was ever seen, no line ever plotted. Somebody had been looking at it a long time.

victory.speaker: shai
victory.text: Four positions and a tube. That is more of Sur than anybody has had since the shelling started.

defeat.speaker: idit
defeat.text: We came back with part of it. The part we did not get is the part that has been killing people.

briefing: Sur begins at the pass, and the pass is watched. Rockets have been falling on the north for a week and nobody can say from where, so tonight you find out. Push the drone up the valley and build the picture — two ATGM pockets on the wall, a Grad section behind it, and whoever is feeding them targets. Keep the metal in the hollow: the valley floor south of it is out of the battery's reach, and everything north of it is not. Herders are grazing that floor north of the hollow — get them south to the muster ground inside five minutes, before the battery finds the range. Bring back the picture, not casualties.

objectives.text: Identify whoever is spotting for the battery

say.speaker: idit
say.text: That one is not a picket. He is lying still on the west lip with the whole valley in front of him, and everything that has fallen on the north fell because a man was doing that.

objectives.text: Find the Grad section behind the wall

say.speaker: idit
say.text: The tube is behind the wall, thirty-eight tiles from your start line. Sight six — it has never once seen the thing it was firing at.

objectives.text: Stay in the field for four minutes
Get the herders off the valley floor before the battery finds the range

say.speaker: net
say.text: Herders are off the floor. Whatever the battery ranges onto tonight, it will not be them.

say_on_fail.speaker: shai
say_on_fail.text: The battery walked its fire onto the floor before the herders were clear of it. That ground was never ours to spend.
